    "(Tutorial_OpenMM_Add_forbidden_plane_region)=\n",
    "# Add forbidden plane region\n",
    "\n",
    "*Preventing atoms from entering a half-space bounded by a 3D plane in OpenMM.*\n",
    "\n",
    "The function {func}`molsysmt.third_party.openmm.forces.add_forbidden_plane_region` adds a repulsive potential that keeps atoms from penetrating across a defined planar boundary.\n",
    "\n",
    ":::{versionadded} 1.0.0\n",
    ":::\n",
    "\n",
    ":::{admonition} API documentation\n",
    ":class: dropdown\n",
    "\n",
    "Follow this link for a detailed description of the input arguments, raised errors, and returned objects: {func}`molsysmt.third_party.openmm.forces.add_forbidden_plane_region`.\n",
    ":::\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "a73a9807",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Basic usage\n",
    "\n",
    "Let's add a forbidden half-space restraint:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "b9cfc3b2",

   "source": [
    "import molsysmt as msm\n",
    "\n",
    "molsys = msm.convert(msm.systems['Trp-Cage']['1l2y.h5msm'], to_form='molsysmt.MolSys')\n",
    "force = msm.third_party.openmm.forces.add_forbidden_plane_region(molsys, point='[0,0,0] nm', normal_vector=(0,0,1), selection=[0], force_constant='5000 kJ/(mol*nm**2)', return_force=True)\n",
    "print('Forbidden plane region created:', type(force))"
